sentences.text: Commissioning shall begin only after the installed equipment baseline for the Atlas Onboard Controller, Dual Channel Odometer, Train Radio Modem, and wayside control equipment has been configuration checked against the approved release record.

The test-train phase shall use non-passenger movements to prove train localization, movement authority processing, braking response, radio continuity, and operator displays under controlled operating conditions.

Each test train shall be crewed by a Revenue Train Operator qualified for commissioning duties and supported by a Line Traffic Controller with authority to stop the trial when observed conditions depart from the approved script.

Initial movements shall be conducted at restricted commissioning speeds and shall progress to representative service speeds only after the Atlas Onboard Controller and North District Zone Controller demonstrate stable supervision.
The South District Zone Controller shall be commissioned under the same test regime so that boundary behavior is verified before whole-line operation is attempted.

East Junction Interlocking and West Junction Interlocking shall remain under enhanced monitoring during migration because route setting, point detection, and authority release behavior are critical to mixed-mode operation.

The staged migration from legacy signalling shall divide the railway into controlled areas that can be commissioned, operated, and, if necessary, returned to legacy control without affecting uncommissioned areas.
Cutover planning shall define the exact control boundaries, permissible train movements, staffing levels, and rollback conditions for each migration stage.
Before any cutover stage, the Safety Data Communication Network and Wayside Radio Access Network shall be verified for coverage, latency, redundancy, and alarm presentation at the control center.
Metro Operations Control System uses the status snapshot to confirm that platform interface conditions are suitable before authorizing the associated commissioning scenario.
The Platform Screen Door Controller shall be included in end-to-end tests that confirm safe coordination between platform equipment, train stopping position, and supervised door enablement.
The Service Timetable Server shall provide trial schedules that exercise normal headways, recovery margins, terminal reversals, and junction conflicts without carrying passengers.
The Passenger Information Gateway shall be observed during operational rehearsal to confirm that public-facing messages remain consistent with the planned commissioning condition.
Voice Dispatch Console procedures shall be rehearsed for test-train dispatch, abnormal stop instructions, evacuation coordination, and return to depot instructions.
The Maintenance Diagnostic Server shall collect commissioning diagnostics so that intermittent radio, odometry, controller, and interlocking events can be reviewed before acceptance.

The Cryptographic Key Management Appliance shall be confirmed as available, synchronized with the approved security baseline, and capable of supporting commissioning operations without manual workarounds.

Readiness reviews shall be held at the completion of each stage and shall include representatives from operations, signalling maintenance, rolling stock, communications, safety assurance, and cyber security.
A Signal Maintenance Engineer shall verify that field defects raised during test running have been closed, deferred with approved controls, or assigned to a post-commissioning monitoring plan.
A Cyber Security Officer shall confirm that access controls, event monitoring, operator accounts, and security incident escalation paths are effective before revenue operation is recommended.

Operational rehearsal shall use realistic degraded scenarios including radio coverage loss, failed train initialization, controller switchover, interlocking unavailability, and control center workstation failure.
The rehearsal shall demonstrate that the Line Traffic Controller can maintain safe service regulation while the Revenue Train Operator follows onboard indications and rulebook instructions.
Acceptance for revenue service shall require completion of planned test cases, closure of safety-critical defects, successful rollback demonstration, and approval of the operations readiness record.
No open defect shall be accepted for revenue service unless its operational restriction, maintenance response, and passenger impact have been assessed and approved by the readiness review authority.

Final entry into revenue service shall occur only after management confirms that training, documentation, staffing, spare equipment, monitoring arrangements, and emergency procedures are in place for sustained operation.
